title: Make the unified material matrix and grade templates the single material lookup for ERP and VanillaSoft
objective: Both importers resolve a material description by one lookup in the committed matrix plasticos_material_profile/data/material_mapping.csv. A mapped row resolves through its grade template first (get_template_values), then overlays only the row's own extras (attributes, color, grade, filler, process, packaging). Templates carry the mapping: routing is generic by polymer and form, so most rows need only a template code. The three phrase tables in material_normalizer.py, the old VanillaSoft map CSV, and its test are retired.

todos.task: Replace the builder's hand-coded TEMPLATE_MATCH with generic routing. A mapped material row routes to the template whose polymer and form equal the row's, falling back to the polymer-only template when the row has no form. Discriminators: LDPE FILM uses grade (A to LDPE_FILM_A) and color MIXED (LDPE_MIXED_FILM); PLASTIC_PALLETS with no_metal uses PALLETS_NO_METAL. Narrow templates route by name words only, never by polymer and form: IBC_TOTES (ibc), HDPE_TOTERS (toter), PET_TRAYS (tray), PET_PARTS_PI (post industrial), PP_SUPERSACS_NO_LINERS (supersac + no liner). A template fills only empty columns; is_clean and no_metal flags add clean and no_metal attributes; a description saying baled or bales sets packaging bales. check() fails when a row's template polymer differs from the row polymer.
todos.shared_root_cause: templates exist but are not used

todos.task: After operator approval of the list (checkpoint C1), seed the candidate templates in grade_template_data.xml, packaging taken from the nearest existing template of the same form, quality_tier standard unless named. Polymer + form: PLASTIC_PALLETS (plastic_pallets, pallets, loose), WOOD_PALLETS (wood_pallets, pallets, loose), HDPE_PALLETS and PP_PALLETS (pallets, loose), HDPE_BOTTLES and PET_BOTTLES (bottles, bales), COMMINGLED_1_7 and COMMINGLED_3_7 (bottles, bales, source POST_CONSUMER), HDPE_REGRIND, HMW_REGRIND (regrind, gaylords), HMW_DRUMS (hdpe_hmw, drums, loose), HDPE_TOTES (totes, loose), HDPE_BUCKETS (buckets, loose), PP_PURGE (purge, gaylords), PP_PARTS and HDPE_PARTS (parts, gaylords), LDPE_FILM_B (ldpe, film, bales, grade_b). Polymer only: MRP, HDPE_HMW, PVC, NYLON, ABS, PC, LLDPE, PS, HIPS. Regenerate the matrix; reusable stays a row attribute on WOOD_PALLETS rows.

todos.task: Rewrite material_normalizer.py around the matrix. Load material_mapping.csv once per process with odoo.tools.misc.file_open and index rows by (field_role, match_key) after whitespace collapse and case folding. normalize_material(env, description, hints=None) returns MaterialNormalization with polymer, form, source_type, attributes, grade, plus template, color, filler_type, process_type, packaging_type, and skip. mapped: start from template.get_template_values() when grade_template is set, then overlay the row's non-empty columns. not_material and note_not_material: skip=True, no unresolved. ambiguous, unknown, or no row: unresolved ('unresolved material',). hints are form, type, and color tokens; each hint row fills empty columns only, and a hint naming a different polymer is ('conflicting material evidence',). A row naming a master missing from the database is unresolved with the missing code. Delete _SPECS, _CRM_EXACT, _CRM_ALIASES, and normalize_crm_material.
todos.shared_root_cause: two phrase systems for one mapping

todos.task: Switch both importers to the one lookup. orchestrator._resolve_material calls normalize_material(env, phrase, hints=structured values) and drops the normalize_material type-hint probe and _HINT_STATUS_UNSUPPORTED; a hint with no matrix row is an OPTIONAL_CONTEXT notice. _store_normalized_materials skips skip=True results silently. _write_profile_classification writes template values and the overlays (attribute_ids, color_id, filler_type_id, origin_process_type, packaging_type_id, sub_grade, quality_tier, has_metal), filling empty fields and leaving conflicts to the existing empty-or-conflict rule. native_document_import._normalize_line keeps calling normalize_material and gains the same result; skip lines create no material classification.

doc_root_surface_impact.reason: No module is added or removed.
Name material_mapping.csv as the importer lookup and scripts/build_material_mapping.py as its generator.

disconfirming_questions: Does generic routing send PP tubs (PP, PARTS) to PP_SUPERSACS_NO_LINERS? It must not: narrow templates route by name words only.
Does a template overwrite a row value such as LDPE Film Grade A's clean and dry? It must not: templates fill empty columns only.
Does deleting the phrase tables change any mapped row? C2 diffs the regenerated matrix first.

Does reading a CSV at runtime violate the no-CSV-bootstrap doctrine? It creates no records; it is a read-only lookup shipped in the addon. If review rejects that, the builder can emit the same lookup as XML seed data instead.
assumed_false_ifs: A polymer-only template adds nothing. It sets quality_tier and is the anchor for later packaging defaults.
A hint can override the description's polymer. It cannot: a different polymer is a conflict.
stress_test.blast_radius: Installed databases gain nine polymer rows and the approved templates on upgrade. Both importers classify through one table, so ERP worksheet lines gain CRM rules and VanillaSoft gains ERP rules. Profiles gain packaging, color, filler, process, and template defaults that were dropped before. No column or table is dropped.
stress_test.rollback: Revert the branch. New xml ids can be archived with active false. Profiles already written keep their values.

shared_causes: Templates exist but routing used three of them; generic routing lifts coverage from 11% to 71% with no new data.
Two phrase systems (normalizer tables and the matrix) describe one mapping; one matrix removes the drift.
deletions_or_consolidations: _SPECS, _CRM_EXACT, _CRM_ALIASES, normalize_crm_material, the type-hint probe, vanillasoft_material_mapping.csv, test_material_mapping_map.py.
